| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Levels** `levels` | 3 | 0 to 6 | How many times the image is halved. 0 is plain Perona-Malik diffusion. |
| **Steps per level** `iterations` | 10 | 1 to 50 | The diffusion steps at each level. |
| **Edge threshold K** `kappa` | 20 | 1 to 100 | Differences much smaller than K are smoothed, much larger ones are kept as edges. |
| **Step size lambda** `lambda` | 0.2 | 0.05 to 0.25 | How far each step moves. 0.25 is the largest stable step with four neighbors. |
| **Conduction** `conduction` | exp(-(d/K)^2), favors high-contrast edges | exp(-(d/K)^2), favors high-contrast edges, 1 / (1 + (d/K)^2), favors wide regions | The function that turns a difference into a conduction. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect 101 (default) | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | RGB | RGB, Brightness only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
